history_summary: Record two native species-reference correspondences for A1 and A3 in PAH Consortium3.
history_details: The A1 and A3 species descriptors receive native Bacillus_A paranthracis and Bacillus licheniformis reference correspondences: respectively 210 genomes with fraction 0.99 and 562 genomes with fraction 0.98. These rounded populations do not identify experimental stock assemblies or exact majority numerators. Preserve A1/A3 Consortium 3 with B8-1 absent, 16S/marker uncertainty, distinct planktonic and static-biofilm assays, substrate-removal versus mineralization limits and all original source statements. Bacillus_A is a lineage label difference, not formal stock renaming. Issues 2317-2319 remain separate source/assay/optimization/marker findings. Only two selected GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All prior history remains unchanged; this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
